reason: ₹22,000 is almost two months of what I earn, and ₹1,999 a month for a year is too much when hand-washing costs us nothing. My inverter and battery already have to cover lights and fans in the evening cuts, so a washer is not where my money goes first.
objection: I would be paying a big amount, or locking into a year of EMI, to replace something we already do for free. And two loads on the battery sounds fine, but if the battery goes weak after the warranty I am stuck with an expensive machine and a long trip to the dealer.
would_change_my_mind: If it came down to around ₹12,000-13,000 with the solar panel included, or an EMI under ₹800 a month, I would think about it seriously.
